description: Mathematicians have developed an algorithm that solves the Four Color Theorem in linear time, reaching the fastest possible theoretical running time for coloring planar graphs. title: A Mysterious 2,600-Year-Old Structure Lies Beneath Egypt’s Mound of the Pharaohs, Hidden for Centuries

description: A tiny fossil flower dating back around 100 million years has been discovered inside a sandstone specimen collected more than 130 years ago. The find offers new evidence of how flowering plants developed during the age of dinosaurs.

title: A Shipwreck Hidden on a Remote Island for 153 Years Is Revealing New Clues
description: Archaeologists investigating a remote island off southern Argentina have uncovered shipwreck remains and evidence of a temporary camp that may be connected to an 1873 maritime disaster. The findings could help clarify how a group of sailors survived after losing their vessel in one of Patagonia’s isolated coastal regions.

title: Scientists Sent a Robot Into the Mariana Trench and Found Rock That Shouldn’t Be There
description: A remotely operated submarine has uncovered evidence of explosive volcanic eruptions more than 6,000 meters beneath the Pacific Ocean, near the deepest known point on Earth's seafloor. The discovery in the Mariana Trench reveals volcanic activity in a region where scientists would not normally expect molten rock to reach the surface.

title: Scientists Uncover a Surprising New Source of Pollution in London and Beijing, and It’s Not Cars
description: Cooking has become a larger source of certain airborne particle emissions than vehicle exhaust in parts of London and Beijing, according to a new study examining pollution in three major cities. The findings show how changes in transportation emissions have altered the sources of pollution released into urban air.

title: Buried in a Somerset Field for Centuries, This 1,100-Year-Old Jewel Carries a Message From England’s Past
description: A medieval jewel discovered in a Somerset field in 1693 bears an inscription linking it to King Alfred the Great. Made from gold, enamel, and rock crystal, the object may have been used to help readers follow religious manuscripts during the ninth century.

title: Voyager 1 Just Crossed the One-Light-Day Mark, and Its Journey Is Far From Over
description: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft reached a distance of one light-day from Earth on November 18, 2026, becoming the first human-made object to travel that far. The milestone came 49 years, two months, and 12 days after its launch, marking another achievement for a mission originally designed to explore Jupiter and Saturn. At 10:16 a.m. UTC, the spacecraft crossed the threshold, placing it approximately 25.9 billion kilometers (16.09 billion miles) from Earth.

title: Something Strange Happens When Cockroaches Visit These Amazon Flowers After Sunset
description: Cockroaches have been identified as important nighttime pollinators of a flowering shrub in the Brazilian Amazon, where researchers observed the insects carrying pollen between reproductive structures while feeding on nectar. The findings reveal an ecological role for animals more commonly associated with household infestations.

The artifact, weighing 1.2 kilograms (2.6 pounds), was returned to Greece in 2025 after its owner decided that the object belonged in the country where his father had collected it nearly a century earlier.
